tools.name: search
tools.description: Search published FAQ, practice info, contact details, doctors, locations, and blog posts on the national SPG Dental Implants site.

tools.name: get_practice
tools.description: National SPG Dental Implants practice summary. Not a local office.

tools.name: get_contact
tools.description: National phone and how to find a local SPG center.

tools.name: get_doctors
tools.description: List or search published implant doctors. Optional query or doctor slug.

tools.name: get_location
tools.description: Published SPG centers by slug, city, or state. Includes address, phone, opening hours, Google Maps link, local website, and the national location page. hours is an empty list when hours were not published.

tools.name: get_faq
tools.description: Published FAQ questions and answers. Optional keyword filter.

tools.name: get_blog
tools.description: One published national blog post by slug, including the article body.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search, get_blog · Private data: search, get_contact · Public sink: get_blog.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search, get_blog · Private data: search, get_contact · Public sink: get_blog

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
